title: dryopteris sororia
intro: Dryopteris sororia, commonly known as Eastern wood fern, is a type of perennial fern native to eastern North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the potential to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant, protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris sororia include anti-inflammatory, diuretic, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as arthritis, hypertension, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
